sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Vineet Kumar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.420 of 2023, under Section 498A, 304B Ipc &
Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Harpalpur, District Hardoi.

It is argued on behalf of the applicant that the mother-in-law and
father-in-law have been enlarged on bail vide separate orders dated 06.02.2024 and 07.02.2024
passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos.1348 of 2024 & 981 of 2024 respectively.

4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
5. Considering the reasonings as contained in the aforesaid two orders coupled with the fact that the Sudhir vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko. on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147270275/
1 role assigned to the applicant was similar to the other co-accused and there being nothing specific against the applicant with regard to causing physical or mental harassment to the victim for demand of dowry soon before the death and also considering the fact that the applicant has no criminal history, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.

entities.text: Sudhir vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Sudhir be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 13.3.2024 nishant  Sudhir vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko.
